jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.summary:
Heidi's data lives on the growth side more than most companies' data does. Every week, signups become clinicians, clinicians become retained sessions, and retained sessions become the revenue that lets us build the next feature. We need someone who can sit inside that pipeline and tell us, honestly, whether it's working.

You'll spend most of your time embedded with Growth and Marketing, but you'll go wherever the business needs eyes on a number. This month that might be campaign performance and channel mix, next month it's unpacking how user behaviour shows up in revenue retention. You've done this enough times to know how to structure the analysis, find the metric that actually matters, and bring people along without losing them in the SQL.
